title: idl2wrs.c: Fix generation of idl2wrs-dissectors
description:
This hasn't worked since 8ca846436d14da6079a51da4111a860e0f357c36
(September 24, 2016) because the code actually depended on atoi
failing silently and returning 0 when faced with a non integer.

Switch the ws_strtou32 call to being *after* the checks for the
special values '*' and ']'.

We don't need to copy the result into a string buffer and compare,
because ws_strtou32 with a NULL end of string pointer will err in
the cases where the comparison would fail.

idl2wrs.c: Pick up recent changes and regenerate

Pick up some changes from 3489952a810d9c4aafcbcc3c75a23d39f8b1da62
and 2a9bc63325c99653c5da873c273430add3b5e9dd by altering idl2wrs.c
to produce the same results as the manul changes.

Regenerate the dissectors to demonstrate that there is no difference.

Also add regenerating these dissectors to the code check CI, around
the same step as the PIDL dcerpc dissectors.
